```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Purpose: follow-up to `06.5-harmony_batch_integration_check.Rmd`, which found
a stage-driven (e11 vs e12) separation concentrated specifically in the
Mesenchyme population on the original merged UMAP, resolved by Harmony
integration. This script visualises the existing mesenchyme subtype labels
(EndoMT_derived / E11_NCC / E12_NCC_Vegfa / etc., from
`14.9-export_subtype_metadata_for_propeller.py`) on both the original and
Harmony-integrated full-dataset UMAPs, to see whether that sub-structure
looks different before vs after integration.

**This is a standalone exploratory fork** - it only reads already-saved
outputs (the Harmony-integrated object from `06.5` and the subtype CSV from
`14.9`) and does not modify, re-run, or feed back into any existing script
or pipeline object.

# Clean-up environment

```{r clean-up}
rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE))
gc()
options(max.print = .Machine$integer.max,
        scipen = 999,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
        dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
set.seed(42)
```

# Load libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
```

# Set project directories

```{r}
project_repo_dir <- "/home/melanie-smith/workDir/sophieWiszniak/20251104_sophieWiszniak_ncc_pa"
harmony_dir <- file.path(project_repo_dir, "outDir", "06.5-harmony_batch_integration_check")
subtype_csv <- file.path(
  project_repo_dir, "outDir", "14-rna_velocity", "endocardial_mesenchymal_egfp",
  "subtype_proportions_bootstrap", "all_samples_subtype_metadata.csv"
)
out_dir <- harmony_dir # same exploratory output folder, no new pipeline step
```

# Load the Harmony-integrated object and mesenchyme subtype labels

```{r}
obj <- readRDS(file.path(harmony_dir, "final_interesting_cells_0.6_harmony_integrated.rds"))

subtype_meta <- read.csv(subtype_csv, row.names = 1)

# confirm every subtype-labelled barcode exists in this object (same cells,
# same barcode format - the 14.x velocity object was built from this one)
stopifnot(all(rownames(subtype_meta) %in% colnames(obj)))

# join mesenchyme_subtype onto the full object; non-mesenchyme cells get NA
obj$mesenchyme_subtype <- subtype_meta[colnames(obj), "mesenchyme_subtype"]

table(obj$mesenchyme_subtype, useNA = "ifany")
```

# Mesenchyme sub-structure on the full-dataset UMAPs, before vs after Harmony

- Full dataset shown (all 5 cell types, matching the earlier comparison
  plots) - non-Mesenchyme cells greyed out, Mesenchyme cells coloured by
  subtype.

```{r mesenchyme-substructure, fig.width=16, fig.height=7}
subtype_cols <- c(
  "EndoMT_derived"                  = "#E41A1C",
  "EndoMT_derived (proliferating)"  = "#FF7F00",
  "E11_NCC"                         = "#4DAF4A",
  "E11_NCC (proliferating)"         = "#984EA3",
  "E12_NCC_Vegfa"                   = "#377EB8",
  "E12_NCC_Sema3c"                  = "#A65628"
)

p_original <- DimPlot(
  obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "mesenchyme_subtype",
  cols = subtype_cols, na.value = "grey85", order = TRUE, pt.size = 0.3
) +
  ggtitle("Original (merged, not integrated)") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_harmony <- DimPlot(
  obj, reduction = "umap.harmony", group.by = "mesenchyme_subtype",
  cols = subtype_cols, na.value = "grey85", order = TRUE, pt.size = 0.3
) +
  ggtitle("Harmony-integrated") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_substructure <- p_original + p_harmony
ggsave(
  plot = p_substructure,
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "compare_umap_mesenchyme_subtype.png"),
  width = 16, height = 7
)
p_substructure
```

# Same thing, split by stage - does the subtype structure separate by e11/e12 within Mesenchyme specifically

```{r mesenchyme-substructure-by-stage, fig.width=16, fig.height=14}
p_original_stage <- DimPlot(
  obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "mesenchyme_subtype", split.by = "stage",
  cols = subtype_cols, na.value = "grey85", order = TRUE, pt.size = 0.3
) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Original (merged, not integrated) — split by stage")

p_harmony_stage <- DimPlot(
  obj, reduction = "umap.harmony", group.by = "mesenchyme_subtype", split.by = "stage",
  cols = subtype_cols, na.value = "grey85", order = TRUE, pt.size = 0.3
) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Harmony-integrated — split by stage")

p_substructure_stage <- wrap_elements(p_original_stage) / wrap_elements(p_harmony_stage)
ggsave(
  plot = p_substructure_stage,
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "compare_umap_mesenchyme_subtype_by_stage.png"),
  width = 16, height = 14
)
p_substructure_stage
```
